frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far. Positive values decrease the likelihood of repeating the same line verbatim.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

role.description: The role of the message author.

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far. Positive values increase the likelihood of talking about new topics.

return_citations.description: Whether to return citations and search results in the response.

search_context.description: Controls how much search context to use. Affects per-request cost.

stream.description: Whether to stream the response using server-sent events.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Lower values make output more focused and deterministic.

top_k.description: The number of tokens to keep for top-k filtering.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. The model considers tokens with top_p probability mass.

content.description: The AI-generated answer, with inline citation references like [1][2].

citations.description: List of source URLs referenced in the answer.

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the completion was created.

model.description: The model used for the completion.

search_results.description: Detailed search results with titles, snippets, and URLs.

info.description: Perplexity Sonar API — LLM with built-in web search. Returns AI-generated answers with citations from web sources.
info.title: Perplexity Sonar API
